layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no clear setup worth risking capital on right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is stuck in a fearful mood, with Bitcoin down about 2% on the week and dragging most coins lower. The swing trade candidates are either stablecoins (no upside), wildly volatile micro-caps with no reliable data, or coins that have already run up significantly. Solana is the most interesting large-cap, showing relative strength with a +3.9% weekly gain, but lacks a clear technical trigger or catalyst to justify entering today. Patience is the best trade right now.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. Set price alerts for Solana around $72-73 for a potential dip-buy entry. Don't chase anything in a fearful, directionless market.
expert_reasoning: The Fear & Greed index at 29 has been worsening, and BTC dominance at 56.1% signals capital rotating away from alts — both headwinds for alt swing trades. BEAT's -64.6% weekly crash screams capitulation but RSI at 51 is oddly neutral, suggesting the move may not be done and data is unreliable. VELVET is up 107% in a week — chasing that in a fear environment with high BTC dominance is a recipe for getting caught in a retrace. SOL is the cleanest large-cap setup but without RSI/MACD data or a volume breakout confirmation, entering now is premature. The news cycle is net-negative (MSCI exclusion proposals, SEC delays, Polymarket banking issues) with no strong bullish catalyst for any specific alt.

context_banner: Market fear is persistent at 29/100 with no clear technical or catalyst-driven setup — disciplined patience beats forced trades.
